description.value: Hillcrest Centre is a multi-sport recreation facility in Vancouver offering swimming, curling, and ice skating under one roof, and carries a Wikipedia entry indicating it is a well-known public venue. Built to serve the 2010 Winter Olympics, it sits in the Queen Elizabeth Park neighbourhood and draws both local and visiting users year-round. A touring cyclist riding through the area would find a large public facility with the full amenity range typical of a City of Vancouver recreation centre.
